name: tomerhayundev-skills
description: Claude Code plugins and skills by Tomer Hayun: a Remotion promo video pipeline, production deploy pipelines, Codex loops, Google Stitch UI generation, and Wix app development.

plugins.name: remotion-video-pipeline
plugins.description: Build or extend a production Remotion pipeline for product promo videos: manifest-driven clips, four aspect ratios, RTL locales, a beat-locked music bed, measured verification, and publishing. Ships a beat-grid fitter, an audio checker, and a CC BY 4.0 120 BPM track.

plugins.name: deploy-production-level
plugins.description: Production-grade deployment pipeline for web apps on GitHub Actions and Cloudflare: quality-gate CI, PR previews, automated production deploys, git-tag releases, one-click rollback, and a human setup guide. Invoke explicitly.

plugins.name: codex-loop
plugins.description: Iterative Codex CLI loop with Claude as orchestrator. Runs codex exec across multiple iterations, using a Stop-hook loop engine to persist state and Claude to evaluate results each round.

plugins.name: stitch-sdk
plugins.description: Generate UI screens programmatically with the Google Stitch SDK: screens from text prompts, edits, design variants, HTML and screenshot export, and agent integrations.

plugins.name: wix-app-dev
plugins.description: Design, build, and ship production-grade Wix App Market apps: architecture, instance-token auth, webhooks, Blocks widgets, dashboard pages, a Cloudflare Workers + D1 backend, billing, and App Market submission.
